content: {"phoneNote":"The phone header stacks a phone number and a directions link under the name, eating 180px before the hero and duplicating the contact block that follows the hero and the fixed bar.","desktopNote":"Desktop hero is clean and well proportioned, but the phone number and directions appear in the header, again in a contact strip right below the hero, and once more in the footer.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":2,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Remove the phone number and directions link from the phone header (the fixed bar already carries them) so the hero photo and headline start higher on the first screen.","Drop or merge the separate Telefon/Naslov strip directly under the hero; it repeats the header and footer and adds a dead band before 'Kaj projektiram'.","Give the services list a visual anchor (small project photos or plan sketches per row) and tighten the 'Pristop' section on desktop where the text column floats in a lot of empty space."],"blockers":[]}
